name: anti-ai-craft
description: Six reusable skills for design workflows, contextual and outcome-oriented interfaces, concise code, auditing, remediation, and verifiable security.

interface.shortDescription: Workflow, design, code, and security with evidence
interface.longDescription: Six skills with evidence contracts. Design includes 101 original principles for product outcomes with ethical safeguards; design, code, and security may be selected by context, while the complete workflow, audit, and remediation remain manual.
defaultPrompt: Use $anti-ai-design-flow to take this feature from briefing through review.
Use $anti-ai-code to simplify this code without changing its behavior.
Use $anti-ai-security to analyze and fix only confirmed and authorized risks.
